mapper.select: SELECT mc.id AS coverId, COALESCE(mc.ext_common1, rf.road_name) AS coverName, #{tenantId} AS tenantId FROM manhole_cover mc LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON mc.road_id = rf.id WHERE mc.id = #{coverId} AND mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mc.deleted = 0

SELECT mc.id AS cover_id, mc.cover_no AS cover_code, -- 井盖名称：拼接道路名称 + "井盖" CONCAT(COALESCE(rf.road_name, ''), '井盖') AS cover_name, sa.id AS area_id, sa.name AS area_name, -- 详细地址：拼接区域+道路 CONCAT( COALESCE(sa.name, ''), COALESCE(rf.road_name, '') ) AS address, -- 经纬度：默认值兜底 COALESCE(mc.ext_common1, '116.403874') AS longitude, COALESCE(mc.ext_common2, '39.914885') AS latitude, -- 井盖类型 mc.cover_type AS cover_type, -- 井盖状态：数字编码转换 CASE mc.status WHEN '正常' THEN 1 WHEN '异常' THEN 2 WHEN '维修中' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS cover_status, mc.status AS cover_status_name, -- 实时监测数据 CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(mm.tilt_angle AS CHAR), '0'), '°') AS tilt_angle, CONCAT(COALESCE(mm.ext_common1, '0'), 'cm') AS displacement, CONCAT(COALESCE(mm.ext_common2, '0'), 'cm') AS water_level, -- 开合状态转换 CASE sos.status_code WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_open, -- 采集时间格式化 DATE_FORMAT(mm.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS collect_time, -- 设备信息 sd.id AS device_id, COALESCE(sd.name, 'MC-Monitor V2.0') AS device_model, COALESCE(sd.ext_common1, 85) AS battery_level, COALESCE(sd.ext_common2, '-75dBm') AS signal_strength, -- 设备在线状态转换 CASE sd.online_status WHEN '在线' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online_status, mc.tenant_id AS tenant_id, -- 区块链存证信息（示例值） '0x123abc456def789ghi012jkl345mno678pqr901' AS chain_hash, CONCAT('https://chain.genchuan.com/query/', '0x123abc456def789ghi012jkl345mno678pqr901') AS chain_query_url FROM manhole_cover mc -- 关联道路表 LEFT JOIN road_facility rf ON mc.road_id = rf.id AND rf.deleted = 0 -- 关联区域表 LEFT JOIN sys_area sa ON mc.area_code = sa.full_code AND sa.deleted = 0 -- 关联最新监测数据 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM manhole_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC ) mm ON mc.id = mm.cover_id -- 关联设备表 LEFT JOIN sys_device sd ON mm.device_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 -- 关联开合状态字典表 LEFT JOIN sys_open_status sos ON mm.open_status_id = sos.id -- 筛选条件（使用 MyBatis 参数） WHERE mc.id = #{coverId} AND mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mc.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1;

SELECT -- 提取小时（00-23）MySQL 替换 PG 的 TO_CHAR DATE_FORMAT(mm.create_time, '%H') AS hour, -- 根据指标类型取对应字段 CASE #{indicatorType} WHEN 0 THEN AVG(mm.tilt_angle) -- 倾斜角度：取平均值 WHEN 1 THEN AVG(mm.ext_common1) -- 位移距离：扩展字段1（移除PG类型转换） WHEN 2 THEN AVG(mm.ext_common2) -- 井内水位：扩展字段2（移除PG类型转换） END AS indicator_value FROM manhole_monitor mm WHERE mm.cover_id = #{coverId} AND mm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mm.deleted = 0 -- PG B'0' 改为 MySQL 0 -- 近24小时 MySQL 标准语法 AND mm.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mm.create_time, '%H') ORDER BY hour ASC

SELECT CASE #{indicatorType} WHEN 0 THEN mc.tilt_angle_threshold -- 倾斜角度阈值：配置表 WHEN 1 THEN COALESCE(mc.ext_common1, 50) -- 位移阈值：扩展字段1（默认50cm） WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(mc.ext_common2, 30) -- 水位阈值：扩展字段2（默认30cm） END AS threshold FROM manhole_config mc WHERE mc.cover_id = #{coverId} AND mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mc.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, cover_id, device_id, tilt_angle, vibration_data, ext_common1, create_time FROM manhole_monitor WHERE cover_id = #{coverId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT online_status FROM sys_device WHERE id = #{deviceId} AND deleted = 0
